views.label: 1. OWASP & 17-Rule O(n) Normalizer
views.note: OwaspSpreadsheetSecurityValidator and O(n) SpreadsheetValueNormalizer apply 17 MENA, DateFormat, and SourceTimeZoneId rules.

views.label: 2. 5-Sheet CRM Topological DAG
views.note: Account -> Contact -> Lead -> Opportunity -> Activity DAG with PBAC RelatedMultiSheetEntityKeys, sessionResolvedKeys, and cascade deferral.

views.label: 3. Worker Context & Cancel Safety
views.note: Worker claims via IgnoreQueryFilters, enters AmbientContext, emits Outbox completion (retracted on cancel), and handles TenantRequired.

views.label: 4. Quota Lease, FLS & 10 Providers
views.note: Reserves atomic edition quota leases, enforces FLS and RoleAssignabilityGuard, and batches across 10 domain providers.

boundaries.label: 5-Sheet Topological DAG, MENA Normalizer & Quota Core

cards.title: Zero-Coupling Core, OWASP Bounds & 9-Stage O(n) Normalizer
items: DataTransfer.*.csproj hold zero references to CRM, Identity, or PartyKernel — modules opt in via Core.Application IEntityDataExchangeProvider; OwaspSpreadsheetSecurityValidator enforces 25 MB upload / 100 MB uncompressed / 1,000 entries / 100x ratio, macro/DTD blocking, and CsvFormulaGuard.

SpreadsheetValueNormalizer runs 9 deterministic O(n) stages across 17 DataExchangeTransformRule toggles (NFKC/BiDi, digits, nulls, Tashkeel/Tatweel, Alef/ى/ک unification, currency/accounting, E.164, UTC) with zero user regexes.

cards.title: Dynamic 5-Sheet DAG, cf:* Schema & Read-Only Entity Catalog
items: Entity Catalog (/data-exchange) is auto-discovered read-only from DI providers, /custom-fields (cf:*), and Edition entitlements; ParentEntityKeys (DependsOnEntityKeys) drives dynamic RelatedMultiSheetEntityKeys cluster sorting.

Multi-sheet execution propagates sessionResolvedKeys across sheets, persists ExternalLegacyKeyMap idempotent lookups, runs Pass-2 self-FK resolution, and defers failed child rows (PARENT_ROW_FAILED / _CascadeParentRef) to Rejected .xlsx.

cards.title: 7-Role [Authorize] PBAC, DataExchangeJobCompletedEvent Outbox & Leases
items: DataTransferController enforces [Authorize] + [PermissionRequired] without [AdminOnly] across 7 standard roles (6 excluding CRM_SALES_REP for migrations.execute), returning DataTransfer.UnknownEntity (404) on invalid keys and DataTransfer.TenantRequired without tenant context.

Execution reserves 2h leases via TryReserveSlotsAsync, publishes DataExchangeJobCompletedEvent to datatransfer.outbox_messages, and reconciles via ReconcileReservationLeaseAsync + DetachPendingOutboxMessages() on cancel (no destructive post-completion global rollback job).

cards.title: Portal Studio (z-900), @core/data-exchange & 7-Lang Docs SSOT
items: GenericCrudView entityTypeKey auto-mounts DataExchangeToolbarActions and z-[900] DataExchangeStudioOverlay without importing @modules/admin/data-transfer; Platform Super Admins without a tenant see DataExchangeTenantRequiredCard.

All Admin, CRM, and Party views standardize on GenericCrudView getActions ⋯ dropdowns, Showing 0-0 of 0 results pagination, flat matte Nexus CardGrid slabs, and 7-language SCRIPE-Docs-Portal documentation.
